title: Configuration, .env aur Artisan Basics
objectives: `config()` aur `env()` kab use karna hai jaanna
Tinker se code test karna aur apni command banana

sections.heading: Configuration kaise kaam karti hai
sections.body: Saari configuration files `config/` folder mein hain. Jo values machine ke hisaab se badalti hain (database password, debug on/off), woh `.env` file mein rakhte hain. Config file `env()` se woh value padhti hai, aur application ka baaki code `config()` se padhta hai.
explain: `env('APP_NAME', 'Laravel')` – `.env` se value, na mile to default.
Application code mein seedha `env()` mat use karo. Config cache hone par `env()` `null` de sakta hai. Hamesha config file ke through `config()` use karo.

callout.text: `.env` ko Git mein commit mat karo. Usme passwords aur secret keys hoti hain. Repo mein sirf `.env.example` jaata hai.

sections.heading: Real-world example: .env file
sections.body: Local par debug chahiye, production par nahi. Dono jagah code same, sirf `.env` alag.

code.code:
APP_NAME="Laravel Master"
APP_ENV=local
APP_KEY=base64:...
APP_DEBUG=true
APP_URL=http://localhost:8000

DB_CONNECTION=sqlite

explain: `APP_DEBUG=true` – detailed error page dikhata hai. **Production mein hamesha `false`.**
`APP_KEY` – encryption aur sessions ke liye secret key. Naya project banane par apne aap ban jaati hai.

sections.heading: APP_KEY aur project clone karna
sections.body: Git se koi project clone karte ho to `.env` nahi milti. Yeh steps chalao:

code.code:
cp .env.example .env
composer install
php artisan key:generate
npm install && npm run build

sections.heading: Artisan: Laravel ka command line tool
sections.body: `artisan` project ke root mein ek file hai. Iske commands code generate karte hain aur routine kaam karte hain.

code.code:
php artisan list
php artisan help migrate
php artisan about
php artisan route:list
php artisan make:controller ProductController
php artisan make:model Product -m
php artisan config:clear
php artisan optimize:clear

explain: `list` – saari commands. `help <command>` – ek command ke options.
`about` – project, PHP aur environment ki summary.
`make:model Product -m` – model ke saath migration bhi banata hai.
`config:clear` / `optimize:clear` – cache saaf karte hain. `.env` badalne ke baad kaam aate hain.

sections.heading: Tinker aur apni Artisan command
sections.body: `tinker` ek interactive shell hai jahan Laravel ka code seedha chala kar dekh sakte ho. Chhoti commands `routes/console.php` mein closure se bhi bana sakte ho.

code.code:
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;

Artisan::command('hello', function () {
    $this->info('Namaste, Laravel!');
})->purpose('Greeting dikhao');

versionDiff.heading: Config aur .env: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Laravel 11 ne kuch defaults badle. Neeche ka `.env` structure teeno versions mein lagbhag same hai, par apni `.env` aur `config/` hamesha dekh lo.

items.11: Slim config: kuch config files default mein nahi hoti. `php artisan config:publish` se publish karo. Defaults: SQLite, aur `SESSION_DRIVER`, `CACHE_STORE`, `QUEUE_CONNECTION` `database` par. (`CACHE_DRIVER` ka naam `CACHE_STORE` hua.)
items.12: Same pattern. `php artisan config:publish` available hai.
items.13: Naye project mein bhi `.env` ka default database SQLite hai (13 ke installation docs ke hisaab se). Baaki defaults ke liye apni `.env` check karo.

errors.error: No application encryption key has been specified
`.env` badli par change nahi dikh raha
`env('SOMETHING')` production mein null aa raha hai
errors.cause: `config:cache` chalne ke baad `.env` direct nahi padhi jaati. Tumne `env()` config file ke bahar use kiya.
errors.fix: Value ko config file mein `env()` se lo aur code mein `config('...')` use karo.

debug.body: Config ya environment par shak ho to yeh dekho.

code.code:
php artisan about
php artisan tinker
>>> config('app.debug')
php artisan config:clear

tasks: `.env` mein `APP_NAME` badlo aur `config('app.name')` Tinker se check karo
`APP_DEBUG=false` karke ek galat URL kholo aur error page ka farak dekho
`routes/console.php` mein ek `hello` command banao aur chalao
`php artisan make:model Product -m` chalao aur dekho kaunsi do files bani

quiz.q: Application code mein config value kaise padhni chahiye?
quiz.why: Config cache ke saath safe rehne ke liye `config()` use karo.
Debug true hone par errors mein sensitive details dikh sakti hain.
`php artisan key:generate` naya key set karta hai.

interview.q: `.env` file ko Git mein commit kyun nahi karte?
interview.a: Usme passwords aur secret keys hoti hain. Har environment ki `.env` alag hoti hai. Repo mein `.env.example` rakhte hain.
`env()` `.env` se raw value padhta hai. `config()` config files se padhta hai jo cache ho sakti hain. Code mein `config()` use karte hain.
Saari config files ko ek cached file mein jod deta hai taaki application tez chale. Iske baad `.env` direct nahi padhi jaati.
Interactive REPL jisme Laravel application ka code (models, config) seedha chala kar test karte hain.
`php artisan make:command Name` se class banate hain, ya chhoti command `routes/console.php` mein `Artisan::command()` se.

summary: `.env` machine-specific values rakhta hai, config files unhe `env()` se padhti hain.
